QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default) | `calloc` | Macro in `platform.h:166-167`. No wrapper function exists.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (PLATFORM_MEMORY off), `mbedtls_calloc` is a macro resolving directly to `calloc` with no wrapper function. It does not mention `mbedtls_free` in that table row, but the same section says "The same applies to free".
